description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'NotesDao' responsible for interfacing with an SQLite database using the sqflite package. It provides methods for CRUD operations on 'notes', including inserting, updating, retrieving, and deleting notes, as well as managing synchronization state.

classes.name: NotesDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class implementing local data source operations for notes, handling CRUD and sync state management in a SQLite database.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a single note in the database.

methods.name: upsertNotesInTransaction
methods.description: Inserts or replaces multiple notes within a database transaction.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: getAllNonDeletedSorted
methods.description: Retrieves all notes not marked as deleted, sorted by last update time descending.

methods.name: getAllIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, including those marked as deleted.

methods.name: getDirtyNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes marked as dirty.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and dirty.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks specified notes as clean (not dirty).

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Deletes notes marked as deleted and not dirty.

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Retrieves the last synchronization timestamp for a given key.

methods.name: setLastSyncAt
methods.description: Sets the last synchronization timestamp for a given key.
